title: The kb MCP coord_post description says an intent with a session field shows in the digest only while that session's presence lease is held
goal: the coord_post tool description names the session/<id> claim (coord_claim) that an intent with a session field needs to show in the digest

clauses.clause: the coord_post tool description names the session/<id> claim (coord_claim) that an intent with a session field needs to show in the digest

gates.question: Where does the coord_post description state the session/<id> claim?

notes: Goal before the 2026-10-17 plan: SP-6jfnx5i3 review G4 (ST-nlesmlru, BG-iwqcj5zf): digest drops an intent whose session/<id> lease is not held, but the coord_post tool description does not say so, so an MCP client that posts an intent with a session field and never claims session/<id> gets no digest line for it and no error. The coord_post description names the session/<id> claim (coord_claim) an intent with a session field needs. Plan 2026-10-17: check on origin/main b871374b4 exits 1 (the description does not name the claim). The redact test reads every tool's tools/list entry: if its assertion refuses the new description, stop and report (the test file is outside the touches by the test policy).
